question: In a certain code language, TIRED is coded as 56, and FRESH is coded as 56. How will HEAVEN be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Sum of the position values according to English alphabetic series is written.

So,

 
• TIRED is coded as 56

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24d04f0405ed42bf4cc4a2133f393fc8dcc7fa4fbec69e0d471c77685279163e.png] 

And,

 
• FRESH is coded as 56

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ed8500d9127f030f335407c741a0315e426d1e8e1ef0b55397647e2c04b6331.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• HEAVEN will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c00e2fad1c4366697966ba0630b8dc69b4423e2cdd84fc379d25668809d5c711.png] 

​Hence, "55" is the correct answer.

7b
